source_assertions.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source_assertions.claim: Green links late-1910 British parliamentary disruption with eclipse and lunation testimony inside the yearly mundane framework.

source_assertions.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source_assertions.claim: Raphael says the December 29, 1909 Saturn-Mars conjunction in Aries, ruling England, brought serious troubles during its rule to August 16, 1911, and that serious difficulties arose in Parliament in connection with the House of Lords.

label: Collapse of the French Third Republic in 1940

source_assertions.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source_assertions.claim: Green says the collapse of France in 1940 was shown in the United Kingdom 1801 national map by progressed Moon conjunct Saturn in the eleventh house, connecting the event with allied and institutional breakdown.

source_assertions.title: Britannica on the French Third Republic collapse in 1940
source_assertions.claim: Britannica states that the Third Republic ended with the fall of France in 1940 and that the June-July 1940 transition produced the Vichy regime after the armistice and full-powers vote.

notes: Post-Phase-5 hardening case: non-British institutional collapse under military defeat and constitutional replacement.

label: National Assembly ends the French Fourth Republic in 1958

source_assertions.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source_assertions.claim: Green says hard Sun-Uranus and Sun-Neptune conditions can bring government defeat, failed measures, and collapse, and he also records the chart data for the French Fourth Republic founded on October 30, 1946.

source_assertions.title: Britannica on the French Fourth Republic collapse in 1958
source_assertions.claim: Britannica says the April-May 1958 cabinet crisis opened the way for conspirators, that Algiers activists seized control on May 13 with army support, and that the June 1 vote giving de Gaulle full powers put a de facto end to the Fourth Republic.

notes: Post-Phase-5 hardening case: decisive event marker for non-monarchical constitutional collapse and replacement of a parliamentary regime.
